en.t: An imperial envoy came from the palace.
He read out the imperial decree: she was posthumously granted the Third Rank[\[8\]](#part1330.html#m8).

units.source_text: 这宣读又引起了新的悲哀。

en.t: This announcement stirred up fresh sorrow once again.

units.source_text: 皇上回想这更衣在世时终于不曾升为女御，觉得异常抱歉。

en.t: The Emperor remembered that, while this Intimate was alive, she had never been promoted to Consort, and he felt deeply sorry.

units.source_text: 他现在要让她晋升一级，所以追封。

en.t: Now he wished to raise her by one rank, and so he bestowed the title posthumously.

units.source_text: 这追封又引起许多人的怨恨与妒忌。

en.t: This posthumous honor again aroused resentment and jealousy in many people.

units.source_text: 然而知情达理的人，都认为这桐壶更衣容貌风采，优雅可爱，态度性情，和蔼可亲，的确无可指责。

en.t: Yet those who understood the matter and were reasonable all felt that the Kiritsubo Intimate was graceful and lovely in appearance and bearing, gentle and approachable in manner and nature, and truly beyond reproach.

units.source_text: 只因过去皇上对她宠爱太甚，以致受人妒恨。

en.t: It was only because the Emperor had loved her too excessively in the past that she became the object of others' envy and resentment.

units.source_text: 如今她已不幸身死，皇上身边的女官们回想她人品之优越、心地之慈祥，大家不胜悼惜。

en.t: Now that she had sadly died, the ladies serving near the Emperor remembered her fine character and kind heart, and all mourned her deeply.
"In life one may be truly hateful; after death, all become dear."

units.source_text: 此古歌想必是为此种情境而发的了。

en.t: This old poem must surely have been composed for just such a situation.
